Return all distinct IC50 activity rows (in nM) against human Histone deacetylase 1 (CHEMBL325, SINGLE PROTEIN, Homo sapiens) that have a PubMed ID or DOI. For each row, include compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null.
